expected_value_creation: Make challenge-corpus limitations visible and reproducibly measure whether controlled mutations reveal detection gaps without turning rates into quality claims.
beneficiary: Human, AI, and hybrid QIF reviewers
supporting_evidence: CART reports static seed replay misses failures found by adaptive diverse probes.
Recent monitor red teaming identifies coverage gaps, multi-context attacks, and cost-sensitive false positives.
success_criteria: Seed, mutant, holdout, and benign-control lineage resolves.
Detection, miss, false-alarm, novelty, and role-separation outcomes are reproducible and fail closed.
